products.name: Refrigerated Compressed Air Dryers
products.title: High-Efficiency Refrigerated Air Dryers
products.subtitle: Non-Cycling Direct-Expansion Technology Delivering Constant +3°C Pressure Dew Point Under Extreme Tropical Ambient Conditions

overview.description: Win Equipments WRD Series refrigerated compressed air dryers remove moisture vapor from compressed air networks through precision thermodynamic chilling. Engineered specifically for Indian and GCC tropical environments with ambient temperatures reaching 45°C and air inlet temperatures up to 50°C, WRD dryers protect sensitive pneumatic machinery, CNC spindles, and automated paint lines from liquid water, emulsion sludge, and corrosion.
overview.working_principle: Saturated compressed air enters the high-efficiency 3-in-1 modular aluminum heat exchanger. In the air-to-air regenerator stage, incoming warm wet air is precooled by outgoing cold dry air, reducing refrigeration compressor power demand by up to 40%. Precooled air then passes into the direct-expansion evaporator where it is chilled to +3°C by eco-friendly R134a/R407C refrigerant. Moisture condenses into droplets and is separated by a multi-stage centrifugal demister before automated discharge through a zero-air-loss drain.
overview.pid_flow: Air Compressor → Aftercooler (<45°C) → Wet Receiver Tank → Pre-Filter (3.0μ) → WRD Refrigerated Dryer (+3°C PDP) → Coalescing Filter (0.01μ) → Dry Receiver → Distribution Ring Main

key_benefits.title: 3-in-1 Monoblock Aluminum Heat Exchanger
key_benefits.narrative: Combines air-to-air precooler/reheater, direct-expansion evaporator, and high-velocity centrifugal water separator in a single corrosion-resistant brazed aluminum block. Eliminates interconnecting pipe friction to deliver ultra-low pressure drop under 0.2 bar.

key_benefits.title: Mechanical Hot Gas Bypass Modulation
key_benefits.narrative: Features pressure-balanced hot gas bypass injection that automatically modulates refrigerant flow from 0% to 100% pneumatic demand. Guarantees constant +3°C dew point without evaporator freezing, even during extended zero-demand standby.

key_benefits.title: Copeland / Danfoss Heavy-Duty Compressors
key_benefits.narrative: Hermetic scroll and reciprocating refrigeration compressors engineered for continuous 24/7 industrial duty. Equipped with internal thermal motor protection, high/low pressure safety cutouts, and anti-vibration rubber isolation mounts.

key_benefits.title: Zero Air Loss Electronic Capacitive Drain
key_benefits.narrative: Intelligent non-contact capacitive level sensor detects accumulated condensate and vents 100% liquid without escaping compressed air. Saves over ₹42,000 annually per 500 CFM installation compared to lossy timed solenoid drains.

specifications.design_conditions: Nominal Working Pressure: 7.0 bar g (Max 16.0 bar g) | Max Inlet Temp: 50°C | Ambient Temp: 35°C | Pressure Dew Point: +3°C | Refrigerant: R134a / R407C

Operating pressure range: 4.0 to 16.0 bar g (High pressure models up to 40 bar available on request)

products.name: Heatless Desiccant Air Dryers
products.title: Heatless Twin-Tower Desiccant Air Dryers
products.subtitle: Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) Technology Delivering Guaranteed -40°C to -70°C Pressure Dew Point for Ultra-Critical Industrial Applications

overview.description: Win Equipments WHD Series twin-tower desiccant air dryers eliminate atmospheric moisture vapor to sub-zero dew points. Designed for critical manufacturing where any trace of moisture causes irreversible process failures—such as pharmaceutical formulation, semiconductor fabrication, and sub-zero pneumatic instrumentation—WHD dryers utilize Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) to guarantee -40°C pressure dew point standard (with -70°C optional using 13X molecular sieve).
overview.working_principle: Compressed air enters through dual angle-seat non-lubricated switching valves and flows upward through the online adsorbing desiccant bed. Microscopic pores in the spherical activated alumina adsorb moisture molecules via physical attraction, reducing water content to less than 0.11 g/m³. Simultaneously, 12–15% of dried effluent air is depressurized to atmospheric pressure and routed downward through the offline tower, regenerating the desiccant bed and venting vapor via heavy-duty exhaust silencers. Every 4 minutes, the solid-state controller rotates the adsorption and regeneration roles.
overview.pid_flow: Air Compressor → Wet Receiver → Pre-Filter Grade X (1μ) → Coalescing Filter Grade Y (0.01μ) → WHD Desiccant Dryer (-40°C PDP) → Particulate Dust Filter Grade P (1μ) → Dry Buffer Vessel → Ultra-Clean Process Header

key_benefits.title: High Crush-Strength Spherical Activated Alumina
key_benefits.narrative: Premium 4–8mm spherical desiccant with exceptional surface area (>340 m²/g) and high mechanical attrition resistance. Prevents desiccant dusting and bed compaction even under violent pneumatic load pulsations.

key_benefits.title: High-Cycle Angle-Seat Pneumatic Valves
key_benefits.narrative: Piston-actuated stainless steel angle seat switching valves tested to over 1,000,000 continuous switching cycles. Zero diaphragm failure risk ensures dependable 24/7 tower changeovers.

key_benefits.title: Dew Point Dependent Switching (DDS) System
key_benefits.narrative: Optional ceramic hygrometer monitors real-time dew point. During low inlet moisture loads, tower regeneration is automatically extended, reducing purge air consumption from 15% down to under 5%.

key_benefits.title: Heavy-Duty Dual Expansion Silencers
key_benefits.narrative: Multi-chamber acoustic exhaust silencers with internal sound baffles dampen rapid tower depressurization noise to under 75 dBA, creating a safe, quiet shop-floor environment.

specifications.design_conditions: Operating Pressure: 7.0 to 16.0 bar g | Inlet Air Temp: 35°C to 45°C | Pressure Dew Point: -40°C Standard (-70°C Optional) | Cycle Time: 8 min (4 min Adsorption / 4 min Regeneration) | Vessel Code: IS 2825 / ASME Sec VIII Div 1

Mandatory After-Filtration: Grade P particulate filter (1μm) installed downstream to capture trace desiccant fines.

overview.description: Win Equipments WCP Series industrial process chillers provide closed-loop liquid thermal management for factory automation, plastic molding, laser cutting, and chemical processing. Built to withstand continuous 24/7 industrial duty in high-ambient environments up to 45°C, WCP chillers integrate high-efficiency scroll compressors, a heavy-gauge insulated SS304 buffer reservoir, and an all-stainless centrifugal circulating pump within a compact powder-coated steel monoblock skid.
overview.working_principle: Process fluid absorbs heat from industrial machinery and returns to the internal SS304 insulated buffer tank. A stainless centrifugal pump draws fluid from the tank and circulates it through a 316 stainless steel brazed plate heat exchanger (or shell-and-tube evaporator) where heat is transferred to eco-friendly R410A/R407C refrigerant. The cooled fluid is delivered back to process equipment at user setpoints from +5°C to +25°C with ±0.5°C PID stability. The large thermal mass of the buffer tank dampens sudden thermal shocks caused by cyclic machine operations.
overview.pid_flow: Machinery Thermal Load → Return Header → SS304 Buffer Tank → SS Centrifugal Pump → SS316 Evaporator Plate → Modulated Refrigeration Loop → Precision Chilled Supply Header → Machine Tools

key_benefits.title: All-Stainless SS304 Non-Ferrous Wetted Loop
key_benefits.narrative: Internal buffer tank, pump impellers, and brazed plate heat exchanger are manufactured from stainless steel. Prevents galvanic corrosion, rust slurry, and clogged cooling channels in expensive molds and laser optics.

key_benefits.title: Modulating Hot Gas Bypass Valve

overview.description: Standard commercial chillers fail rapidly when exposed to aggressive acid electrolytes or when supporting zero-downtime medical imaging magnets. Win Equipments specializes in custom-engineered thermal management packages: WAN Series Titanium Anodizing Chillers resisting 20% sulfuric acid baths; WMS Series Medical Scan Chillers providing dual-redundant cooling for clinical MRI/CT magnets; and WAC Series Acid Process Chillers featuring Hastelloy C-276 metallurgy and sealless magnetic drive pumps.

WMS Medical Chillers feature dual independent refrigeration circuits (2 × 100% capacity) and dual SS316 pumps with auto-failover and an emergency motorized city water bypass that engages automatically upon electrical power failure to prevent catastrophic liquid helium boil-off in superconducting MRI magnets.

overview.description: Win Equipments WFI Series industrial ice flake machines produce continuous, sub-cooled dry ice flakes engineered for commercial fisheries, poultry processing, concrete dam pouring, and chemical synthesis. Unlike conventional rotating-drum ice machines that suffer from refrigerant seal leaks, the WFI Series employs a stationary vertical SUS304 evaporator drum with an internal rotating spiral ice blade, delivering zero refrigerant leakage, ultra-low maintenance, and maximum thermodynamic efficiency.
overview.working_principle: Fresh or seawater is pumped from a lower stainless steel basin into an overhead rotary water distributing pan that coats the inner vertical wall of the stationary evaporator drum with an even, continuous film. Low-temperature eco-friendly refrigerant boiling within the drum jacket freezes the water instantly on the SUS304 inner surface. A high-strength stainless steel helical scraper rotates slowly, peeling sub-cooled dry ice flakes (-5°C to -8°C, 1.5 to 2.2 mm thick) from the wall. The dry flakes drop freely by gravity through the open drum bottom into storage bins or pneumatic conveying systems with zero clumping.
overview.pid_flow: Feed Water → Stainless Basin → Vertical Distribution Pan → Stationary SUS304 Drum Wall (-22°C Evaporation) → Internal Spiral Scraper → Free Fall Dry Flakes (-7°C) → Insulated Storage Vault

key_benefits.title: Stationary Vertical SUS304 Evaporator Drum
key_benefits.narrative: The evaporator drum remains completely stationary while only the internal scraper blade rotates. Eliminates high-pressure rotary mechanical refrigerant seals—the #1 cause of catastrophic refrigerant leaks in rotating-drum machines.

key_benefits.title: Sub-Cooled, Flat & Edueless Flake Geometry
key_benefits.narrative: Produces thin (1.5–2.2 mm) sub-cooled dry flakes with zero free water. Their smooth, rounded edges provide massive surface contact area for rapid thermal exchange without scratching or bruising delicate fish skin or poultry meat.

key_benefits.title: Heavy-Duty Bitzer / Danfoss Refrigeration Package
key_benefits.narrative: Driven by world-renowned Bitzer semi-hermetic reciprocating or screw compressors equipped with liquid injection cooling, oil separators, suction accumulators, and high-efficiency water-cooled shell-and-tube condensers.

key_benefits.title: Food-Grade Hygienic Sanitary Construction
key_benefits.narrative: All surfaces contacting water and ice—evaporator wall, water distribution pan, ice blade, and collection basin—are fabricated from SUS304 food-grade stainless steel compliant with HACCP and USFDA food safety standards.
